name: BR Video Engine
description: Beat templates for Basic Reflex short-form video. Write captions first, plan shots to match.

sparring-prep.name: Sparring Prep
sparring-prep.music_note: Piano or ambient over slo-mo climax. Contrast soft music with hard action.

beats.name: World
beats.shot: Wide or detail — establish the space
beats.notes: Let the gym breathe. No text. Ambient sound.

beats.name: Texture
beats.shot: Detail of worn equipment, surfaces, atmosphere
beats.notes: Tells the story of the space. Worn = real.

beats.name: Subject A Gear 1
beats.shot: First subject gearing up — helmet or wraps

beats.name: Subject A Gear 2
beats.notes: First text can land here or beat 5-6. Keep it one line.

beats.name: Subject B Gear 1
beats.notes: Mirror subject A. Same ritual, different person.

beats.name: Subject B Gear 2
beats.notes: Prep phase builds anticipation through repetition.

beats.name: Face Off
beats.notes: NO TEXT. The image carries it. Silence or music shift.

beats.name: Trigger
beats.shot: The moment before action — glove tap, nod, 'let's go'
beats.notes: Energy shift. If text here, make it the turn ('Not to win.' / 'This isn't about winning.')

beats.name: Intimate
beats.example: Close up of boxer 2's face through helmet — focused
beats.notes: Emotional peak of prep. Best slot for the core message.

beats.name: Ready Detail
beats.shot: Hands, gloves, stance — the body says 'ready'
beats.example: Pan down to boxer 2's glove — ready

beats.name: Wide Action
beats.shot: Wide shot — guards up, action begins
beats.notes: Full context. See both subjects. Real speed.

beats.name: Action Detail
beats.shot: Close or mid shot — a punch, a slip, contact
beats.notes: Quick. Impact. Can cut between multiple angles.

beats.name: Slo-Mo Release
beats.example: Sparring starts 120fps slo-mo, piano to contrast violence
beats.notes: THIS IS THE MOMENT. One line of text max. Music contrast (soft over hard). Longest beat. Let it breathe.

beats.name: Logo
beats.shot: Logo on black or over final freeze
beats.notes: Clean. Logo + optional tagline. 'Train Here. Apply Everywhere.' or custom CTA.

text_rules.silence_is_power: Face off (beat 7) should NEVER have text. Slo-mo (beat 13) gets ONE line max.
text_rules.voice: Direct. Short. No motivational cliches. BR voice = real, not aspirational.
good_patterns: Statement of fact, not instruction ('The ring doesn't care about your day.')
Negation reframe ('Not to win. Not to prove anything.')
Question to viewer ('When did you last do something uncomfortable?')

workflow: 1. Pick template (or create new from edit)
4. Plan shots to match beat map
5. Shoot with beat durations in mind
